items.title: General Motors’ Stock: Is GM Outperforming the Consumer Discretionary Sector?
items.summary: General Motors’ stock has outpaced the broader consumer discretionary sector over the past year, and analysts remain reasonably upbeat about its prospects.

items.title: GM, Ford Turn EV Battery Bust Into Energy Storage Bet
items.summary: Ford and GM are repurposing underused EV battery capacity for energy storage, seeking new revenue after taking billions of dollars in EV-related write-downs

items.title: General Motors (GM) Has One Operational US EV Battery Plant
items.summary: General Motors (NYSE:GM) now has ownership in just one operational US electric vehicle battery plant as its North American manufacturing footprint shifts. The company is scaling back parts of its US EV battery production while keeping EV supply chain commitments under review. GM has committed a new C$144 million investment to expand pickup truck assembly in Canada, focused on higher margin models. items.title: Workers reeling after VW cuts open door to factory closures
items.summary: The day after Volkswagen management, shareholders and unions agreed to cut a total 100,000 jobs over the coming years, automotive workers told AFP Friday they were feeling a mix of fury and disappointment.Management and unions agreed Thursday only to seek "alternative uses" for the plants.

items.title: The Lowe’s Foundation wants to train 1 million craft workers
items.summary: The tool and DIY retailer’s foundation has partnered with Nvidia, General Motors and other U.S. businesses to help bolster the construction labor force by 2035.
